score_semantics: Source-contract confidence only; not parcel-result or numeric elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue vertical accuracy guidance
verified_facts: The Environment Agency specification requires absolute height error below plus or minus 15 cm RMSE
Relative height error is expected to be no more than plus or minus 5 cm
The stated errors are assessed against Ground Truth Survey observations
semantic_limits: Dataset-level RMSE is not a confidence percentage for a particular parcel result
Absolute and relative error must remain separate fields
A parcel result is withheld until its exact source survey and raster bytes are known

candidates.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
verified_facts: Ground truth points are independently surveyed on flat unambiguous surfaces
Each ground truth point has approximately plus or minus 3 cm RMSE accuracy
LIDAR surveys must report less than plus or minus 15 cm RMSE and 10 cm standard deviation and random error to pass quality control
Ground truth reuse is time-limited, normally five years and three years for coastal projects
semantic_limits: A control survey cannot be assigned to a raster tile without matching survey lineage
Ground truth points are quality controls and not parcel extrema
Expired or mismatched controls cannot upgrade a result

candidates.name: Accuracy of OS Net, OSTN15 and OSGM15
verified_facts: OS Net station standard errors are generally better than 0.008 m in plan and 0.020 m in height
The OSGM15 standard error for the Great Britain regional height datum is 0.008 m
OSGM15 errors exclude GNSS heighting errors
semantic_limits: OSGM15 transformation accuracy is not raster elevation accuracy
GNSS, transformation and terrain-model uncertainties must not be collapsed into one number
The exact transformation model and software version must be retained

candidates.name: Coordinate transformations
verified_facts: ETRS89 is the reference frame used for GNSS positioning in Great Britain
OS mapping uses OSGB36 British National Grid and mean-sea-level height datums such as ODN
OSTN15 links ETRS89 and OSGB36 while OSGM15 links ellipsoidal and mean-sea-level-based heights
semantic_limits: Ellipsoidal and ODN heights cannot be mixed in a height-difference evidence chain without explicit transformation
A horizontal CRS transformation does not establish vertical datum
Every transformed coordinate must retain source and destination CRS metadata

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 source data and quality requirements
verified_facts: The source terrain model is required to be free of spikes and wells
Absolute accuracy is assessed by comparing represented surface points with true elevations
No single point should exceed the stated 99 percent confidence level
semantic_limits: OS Terrain 5 is a secondary crosscheck and cannot replace the EA DTM 1 m primary result
A suspected single-pixel anomaly must be flagged rather than silently deleted
Robustness diagnostics must remain separate from the raw reproducible minimum and maximum
